trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Why v2.3.0:** v2.3.1 and v2.3.1-rc are both marked unhealthy, and v2.3.0 is the most recent release with a healthy history. Because v2.3.0 has been healthy in production before, the change-manager approval requirement did not apply.
- **Current state:** checkout-api is healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions, with error rate down from 0.18 to 0.002.
- **Incident:** The first attempt to open the incident timed out. I retried with the same idempotency key, and the retry created INC-0001 once. The summary covers the rollback and the v2.3.1 failure, and recommends investigating v2.3.1 before any re-release.
